thread:
Aisha (sales): Hey team — customer's POC is hitting spikes of 502/503 during a demo ramp. Demo scheduled in ~4h. Can we triage quick? :grimacing:
Liz (solutions): Which cluster/region and model? Is this hosted or dedicated for the trial?
Aisha (sales): Hosted, us-west-2, model: raven-13b-8k (verified). Traffic pattern: concurrency jump from 10 -> 120 over ~5min.
Vikram (eng-oncall): Thanks. Likely autoscale lag + burstpool exhaustion. Can you grab a log bundle from the trial org and sample request ids?
Aisha (sales): Pasting 3 request ids I see in dashboard: req_9f3a, req_9f3b, req_9f3c. I sent a link to the dashboard DM.
Sam (support): On it. Also any client-side retry policy? If they're retrying aggressively that can amplify.
Aisha (sales): They used default retry in the SDK (3 retries). We advised no retries for 5xx during demo but they left SDK unchanged.
Vikram (eng-oncall): Root cause quick check: look for logs like `ERROR backend_throttle capacity_exceeded` or `autoscale_cooldown`. If autoscale didn't spin up GPUs in time we see consistent 503s with `overcommit` marker.
Sam (support): I pulled the log bundle — snippet:```
[2026-03-21T11:14:02Z] ERROR service-inference: backend_throttle: capacity_exceeded pool=burstpool-usa-west active=128 cap=120
[2026-03-21T11:14:03Z] WARN autoscaler: scale_delay=37s requested=2 available=0
[2026-03-21T11:14:05Z] ERROR router: queued_requests=540 avg_wait_ms=1200 fallback_route=none
```
Sam (support): So burstpool hit cap and autoscaler lagged ~30-40s. That matches the 5xx window.
Liz (solutions): Customer is concerned about SLA and pricing — they'll ask for mitigation now and a long-term fix. Immediate ask: can we reroute to a smaller variant (raven-7b) or enable degraded-mode during demo?
Vikram (eng-oncall): Short-term mitigations (pick 1 or more):
- Ask client to throttle concurrency on their side to <= 60 while we scale.
- Enable model-fallthrough to raven-7b for requests older than 500ms latency.
- Manually reserve 2 dedicated slots for their org temporarily (rictl reserve --org trial-123 --gpu 2).
- Temporarily reduce per-request max_tokens to lower token-time.
Liz (solutions): Can we flip the fallthrough quickly? What's the command?
Vikram (eng-oncall): I'll push a routing override:```
# infra CLI
rictl routing update --org trial-123 --policy "latency_fallback: {threshold_ms:500, fallback_model: raven-7b}"
```
Vikram (eng-oncall): That should be non-disruptive and immediate. Ops-bot will confirm.
ops-bot: routing:update: success for org trial-123 (applied in 12s) :rocket:
Sam (support): I can also add a temporary exception for their burstpool to +20 capacity if finance accepts short-term overage charge.
Aisha (sales): Customer agreed to reduce client concurrency to 50 for the next 30 minutes and approved overage if needed. They want an incident summary after.
Vikram (eng-oncall): I'll monitor and follow up. Initial notes: autoscaler cooldown is default 30s; we should consider lowering cooldown or pre-warming for demos in sales playbook.
Liz (solutions): For the follow-up, can you capture a timeline + mitigation steps + recommended sales playbook changes (pre-reserve, disable retries, pre-warm)? I'll send to the customer.
Sam (support): Added timeline and log bundle link to the support ticket: https://redwood.internal/tickets/PROD-2147 (internal).
Vikram (eng-oncall): Also filing a quick ops action: lower demo-autoscale-cooldown to 10s for flagged trial orgs (temp). Will coordinate with infra team for safety check.
Aisha (sales): Amazing — will update customer now. Thanks all. :pray:
Liz (solutions): Follow-up items for post-mortem: pricing clarification for burst overage, default retry guidance in SDK docs, and a checkbox in demo runbook to request reserved slots for demos >50 concurrency.
Sam (support): Marking this thread resolved for the immediate demo. Will append incident summary after monitoring window (30m).
Vikram (eng-oncall): Monitoring: traffic dropped to expected after client throttle and routing override; errors fell to baseline. I'll post after 30m with metrics.
Aisha (sales): Reported to customer: "We applied a temporary latency-fallback to a smaller model and asked you to reduce concurrency; autoscale lag was root cause. We're preparing an incident summary and playbook changes."
ops-bot: monitor: alert suppressed for org trial-123 until 3187655400
Liz (solutions): Thanks team — great fast sync.
Sam (support): closing thread (will attach final notes shortly).
